verdict.rationale: The pack documents no workflow builder or trigger-based automation for SLAs, trial extensions, or discount offers. The closest items are status sync to issue trackers, an MCP server that lets external agents act on feedback, and changelog announcements. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build automated workflows for SLAs, trial extensions, and discount offers triggered by feedback events
